root_cause.text: The function `ublk_check_and_reset_active_ref()` had an incomplete condition that only covered zero-copy and auto-buf-reg modes, missing the user-copy mode (`UBLK_F_USER_COPY`), so requests in user-copy mode leaked their reference count when the ublk server exited, allowing use-after-free or other misbehavior.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes the condition from `if (!(ub->dev_info.flags & (UBLK_F_SUPPORT_ZERO_COPY | UBLK_F_AUTO_BUF_REG)))` to `if (!ublk_dev_need_req_ref(ub))`, ensuring all reference-counted data copy modes are handled. The CVE description explicitly states that "the reference count leak also affects UBLK_F_USER_COPY, the other reference-counted data copy mode."
